Talata Men, 3. Division basketball in Copenhagen

Talata Men is the club's senior team. We play 3. Division Herrer Øst in the Danish federation and train Monday and Friday.

Ages
18 and up
When
Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole
Where
Svanemøllehallen, Østerbrogade 240, 2100 København Ø · Nørre Fælled Skole, Biskop Krags Vænge 7, 2200 København N
Price
2.000 kr per half-season
Book a trial

The team

3. Division

The registered team. We play 3. Division Herrer Øst in the DBBF league, plus the Danish Cup. The Final Four is the route up to 2. Division. Expect league games most weekends and a tryout to get on the roster.

Coached by Deng Awak

Talata's head coach captained Mount Royal University in Calgary and played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark. He still plays with the team, alongside Jordan Naughton, who played NCAA Division 1 at Wyoming. Deng's full profile

Just want to play?

Talata & Co. is our team for men and women, 18 and up, every level. No league and no weekend games. Fridays at Svanemøllehallen, food together after. Talata & Co.

Games

League, cup and friendlies. Anyone is welcome to come and watch a home game before they decide.

Danish Cup, 1/8 final

BK Amager 93, Talata 79

The cup run ended at the 1/8 final, away to a side two divisions above us. Before that, an 89 to 87 overtime win over Hørsholm.

Next up is the 3. Division season. The federation is still moving dates, so check the games page before you travel.

Prices

All prices and the other age groups are on the prices and times page.

Questions

When do you train?

Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole. There is no Wednesday session.

How does the first session work?

It is free. Come Monday or Friday, whichever suits you. Book it and we email you the session. Bring indoor shoes.

Can a few friends join together?

Yes. Book a trial each and come the same night. Talata Men is a league team with a tryout. For a group that wants to play without the league, Talata & Co. on Friday suits better.

What does it cost?

2.000 kr per half season. That covers the hall, the coaching and your league registration.

What level is the team?

We play 3. Division Herrer Øst in the Danish federation, plus the Danish Cup. The Final Four is the route up to 2. Division. Beginners and players coming back after years off start at Talata & Co.

Book a trial

Your first session is free. Book it and we email you the session, then come with indoor shoes.
